rows.grounds: accusative singular masculine pronoun referring to the hidden true nature
compound of gūḍha and sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
neuter abstract noun in nominative singular
middle voice present third singular from root prajan

items.question: What arises upon knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing the hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
